$comment: Structured-summary block schema for the first-principles agent. Canonical source: shared/spine/references/summary-schema.json. Emitted verbatim to first-principles/references/summary-schema.json by scripts/sync-content.py --write: edit the source, never the emitted copy. This is a hand-validatable field table, not JSON Schema; reading it needs no validator dependency.
versioning: schema_version is an integer starting at 1. Changes are add-only: adding a field keeps the version; removing or renaming a field, or narrowing an enum, increments it.

block.heading: ## Structured summary (process output)
block.placement: The last element of the delivered file's ## Appendix — process output: the heading, then exactly one fenced json block, and nothing after it.
block.final_message: The agent's final message does not carry the block; it exists only in the delivered file.
block.status: Process output that restates decisions the document already records and adds none. It is not environment state (the output template's environment-state rule applies unchanged) and not a seventh output section. A reader who ignores it loses nothing.

run_mode.source: The Step 0 MODE the run used, verbatim: full-composer or focused-<technique>.
run_mode.null_when: The document records no Step 0 mode (a legacy worked example). An agent report never writes null.

assumptions.source: Section 2 Assumptions Table: one item per row, in row order.

id.source: A-n, where n is the row's 1-based position in the section 2 table: the same A-N the chains' [Assumes: A-N] marks and the Assumption Audit scan use. The table itself carries no ID column.

type.source: The row's Type cell's parent type (a trailing parenthesised subtype is dropped): exactly one of the four types.
type.null_when: Legacy worked examples only: the row's Type cell is not a single taxonomy type (a pre-taxonomy value such as `factual`/`value`, which assumption-taxonomy.md says must not be backfilled, or a compound `a / b` cell). An agent report never writes null.

verdict.source: The token that leads the row's Verdict cell, before its em-dash.

ground_truths.source: Section 3 Ground Truths: one item per declared ground truth, in declaration order.

id.source: The ground truth's id as section 3 declares it, written without any ? suffix.

read_at_source.source: Judged from the canonical section 3 declaration: false exactly when section 3 declares the id as GT-N? (provenance reported-by-delegate or unverified); true when it declares it unsuffixed (read-at-source).

chains.source: Section 4 Derivation Chains: one item per chain, in document order.

rests_on.source: Every identifier on the chain's head line (the part before the first arrow), in order, written as the head writes it with any ? suffix kept: the same list as the chain's **Pre-check:** head field.

dead_ends.source: The name in each section 5 '### Dead End: [Name]' heading, in order. An empty array when section 5 holds only its Nothing material here line.

techniques.null_when: The document has no Techniques not applied: block (a legacy worked example, which may still apply a technique in its prose). An agent report never writes null. A focused-mode run writes an object (its not_applied may be empty), never null.

applied.source: Each companion technique the run applied, by slug, in first-applied order.

not_applied.source: One item per line of the Techniques not applied: block; an empty array when that block is omitted because every invocation fired.

phase.source: The phase whose invocation of the technique did not fire, per the agent body's procedure.

reason.source: The <reason> of the matching '<technique> — not applicable — <reason>' line, verbatim.

gate.null_when: The document carries no '## Self-Audit Gate (process output)' section (a legacy worked example). An agent report whose gate did not run writes passes as [] and cleared as false, never null.

passes.source: One item per scoring pass, in order: each earlier pass read from its **Pass N (before re-score):** line, the final pass read from the six verdict blocks.

bands.source: The band each of Criteria 1 to 6 received in this pass, in criterion order.

gate_cleared.source: The rubric's Gate cleared condition for this pass: no criterion scores Absent.

hand_wavy_cap_cleared.source: The rubric's Hand-wavy cap cleared condition for this pass: at most one criterion scores Hand-wavy.

fix_repeat_fired.source: Whether the Self-Audit Gate's Fix/Repeat loop fired: the Fix/Repeat fired value of the **Gate result:** line.

cleared.source: Whether the final pass cleared both conditions: the cleared / not cleared value of the **Gate result:** line.

re_entry.null_when: The document records no Self-Audit Gate section and no re-entry disclosure (a legacy worked example). An agent report never writes null.

fired.source: A statement of fact, not a phrase to be searched: true when any of the four re-entry edges fired anywhere in the run; false means no edge fired anywhere.

edges.source: One item per edge that fired, in firing order; an empty array exactly when fired is false.

enum: the second-order pass's return to Phase 2 for re-challenging
the Criterion 1 Absent verdict's return to Phase 1

trigger.source: One short sentence: what triggered the edge (the criterion that failed, or the input that was missing), as the document's re-entry disclosure states it.

recommendation.source: Section 6's **Recommended approach:** text, copied in full and verbatim, including every item of any list it introduces. Never cut at a colon, never paraphrased.

rests_on.source: Every id on section 6's **Pre-check:** head, in the order the head gives them, each Cn without its parenthesised band and each GT-N? with its ? kept: the same ids the chain rests_on field reads from a chain's head, read here from the Conclusion's own Pre-check line.
rests_on.null_when: The document's section 6 carries no **Pre-check:** line (a legacy worked example). An agent report never writes null.

invariants.rule: Every key in required is present. A nullable field may be null only when its null_when condition holds; an agent report populates every field.

Every id the block names (A-n, GT-n, Cn, and every rests_on entry) is one the document uses, and every value agrees with the document. Where they disagree the block is corrected to match the document.
ground_truths[].read_at_source is false exactly when section 3 declares that id as GT-N?, and true exactly when section 3 declares it unsuffixed.
Each gate.passes[] entry has six bands; gate_cleared is true exactly when no band is Absent; hand_wavy_cap_cleared is true exactly when at most one band is Hand-wavy.
gate.cleared is true exactly when passes is non-empty and its last entry has both gate_cleared and hand_wavy_cap_cleared true.

gate.passes lists every scoring pass in order, including a pass that was later rewritten: one entry per **Pass N (before re-score):** line, then one for the final verdict blocks. Its length equals the passes value of the **Gate result:** line.
gate.fix_repeat_fired true implies re_entry.fired true and an edges entry for the Self-Audit Gate's Fix/Repeat loop, because the Fix/Repeat loop is one of the four bounded re-entry edges.
A gate.passes of length two or more implies re_entry.fired true.
re_entry.fired is false exactly when re_entry.edges is empty.

conclusion.recommendation is section 6's **Recommended approach:** in full, including any list it introduces; conclusion.confidence equals section 6's **Confidence:** band; conclusion.rests_on holds exactly the ids on section 6's **Pre-check:** head.

not_applied.reason: no conclusion turns on a magnitude that is uncertain

edges.trigger: Criteria 2 and 4 scored Hand-wavy on the first pass, failing the Hand-wavy cap.

conclusion.recommendation:
Adopt option B (chain C2), in two steps:
1. Pilot it on one team for a month (chain C2).
2. Roll it out if the pilot's defect rate stays at or below today's (chain C1).
